overview.title: 1. Game Overview
overview.body: Bakugan Arena is a strategic turn-based battle game where players deploy Bakugans, use Ability Cards, and control Gate Cards to defeat their opponent.
overview.objective: The objective is simple: eliminate all enemy Bakugans or outlast your opponent through strategic play.

victory.title: 3. Victory Conditions
victory.intro: A player wins the game if:
victory.timer: The opponent's timer reaches 0 (only after Turn 0 conditions are no longer active)

draw.title: 4. Draw Conditions
draw.intro: A match ends in a draw if:
draw.noGates: No more Gate Cards can be placed by either player
draw.mutualElimination: All Bakugans from both players are eliminated in the same turn
draw.timerTurn0: A player's timer reaches 0 during Turn 0

battle.title: 5. Battle System
battle.intro: A battle begins when two opposing Bakugans land on the same Gate Card.
battle.turn1First: The player who first occupied the Gate Card acts first
battle.turn1Gate: Activate the Gate Card (if they own it, and it is neither already activated nor blocked)
battle.turn2Body: The opponent takes their turn with the same options
battle.endGate: The Gate Card effect is resolved (if applicable)
battle.endEliminate: The Bakugan with the lowest power level is eliminated

abilities.title: 6. Ability Cards System
abilities.filter: Ability Cards are automatically filtered by the game before being added to a player's hand.
abilities.unused: If a card cannot be used in the current context, it is not given to the player.
abilities.airBattle: Air Battle — Allows movement to another Gate Card. If no other Gate Cards exist, the card is not added to the hand.
abilities.marionette: Marionette — Allows control/movement of enemy Bakugans. If no valid target exists (e.g., only one Bakugan remains on the field), the card is not added.

neutral.title: 7. Neutral Phase (No Active Battle)
neutral.intro: When no battle is currently occurring, players can perform one action per turn.
neutral.placeGateBody: First possible action. Does not restrict other future actions during the turn.
neutral.deployBody: Second possible action. If performed, the player can no longer place a Gate Card this turn.
neutral.abilityBody: Third possible action. Immediately ends the turn after use. Prevents any other action this turn.

strategic.title: 8. Strategic Note
strategic.intro: Efficient play in Bakugan Arena is about resource timing and board control:
strategic.abilities: Ability Cards can shift momentum but are limited
strategic.overextend: Overextending early often leads to tactical disadvantage
strategic.outro: Mastering the interaction between positioning and ability usage is key to victory.

help.title: 9. Need Help?
help.discord: If you have any questions about the game or if certain rules are unclear, we invite you to join our Discord Community where players and staff members can help you.
help.refresh: If you encounter an issue during a match, please try refreshing the page first, as this resolves most temporary problems.
help.report: If the issue persists or if you discover a bug, please report it on our Discord server so we can investigate and fix it as quickly as possible.
help.thanks: Thank you for playing Bakugan Arena, and most importantly:
help.outro: Have fun and enjoy your battles!
